+def _split_special(text, special):
+    """
+    Same list as re.split("(" + "|".join(re.escape(k) for k in special) + ")",
+    text), without compiling a pattern: the leftmost match wins, and at equal
+    positions the first token in special's order (ordered alternation).
+    """
+    if "" in special:
+        pattern = "(" + "|".join(re.escape(k) for k in special) + ")"
+        return re.split(pattern, text)
+    find = text.find
+    # nxt[k]: first occurrence of k at or after the current position (-1: none)
+    nxt = {k: find(k) for k in special}
+    parts = []
+    app = parts.append
+    pos = 0
+    while True:
+        best = -1
+        tok = None
+        for k, j in nxt.items():
+            if j >= 0 and (best < 0 or j < best):
+                best = j
+                tok = k
+        if best < 0:
+            break
+        app(text[pos:best])
+        app(tok)
+        pos = best + len(tok)
+        for k, j in list(nxt.items()):
+            if 0 <= j < pos:
+                nxt[k] = find(k, pos)
+    app(text[pos:])
+    return parts
+
+
+# the main
